entries.06bdfeef688de28e: Operation and management of mixed-use commercial facilities
entries.484b06600bf455fd: This business operates and manages mixed-use commercial facilities, and conducts real estate sales and brokerage and rental property management. Laox Real Estate Co., Ltd. is in charge, advancing tenant turnover at commercial facilities and the management and sale of real estate held by group companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥1,913 million.
entries.4bd6852f1e963a56: At apparel stores such as “Barneys New York,” operated by Barneys Japan Co., Ltd., it sells men's and women's apparel, sundries and other goods. In September 2025, it carried out a large-scale renovation of the Ginza flagship store.
entries.5bcee9193569e4f1: A holding company centered on retail, including the sale of gift items, duty-free stores, and apparel, and also engaged in trading and real estate services.
entries.98be08b542a8d108: This business develops duty-free store operations aimed at inbound tourists and sells men's and women's apparel, sundries and other goods. Barneys Japan Co., Ltd. operates the apparel store “Barneys New York.” Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥20,841 million.
entries.9ab200f14df85cd1: This food and beverage business operates the Japanese restaurant “Kurogi” within China. It collaborates with Japanese companies that have entered Shanghai and provides small-scale party venues.
entries.9e857768a80ab464: Sales of gift confectionery, sundries and lifestyle products. It is advancing new product development and flavor expansion for its private-label Western confectionery brand “THE SWEETS,” and in September 2025 it made Ginza Suzuya Co., Ltd. a subsidiary, also beginning efforts to expand into Japanese confectionery.

entries.f44185dd1e7c208c: Sale of gift and lifestyle products
entries.f471663fa35a85f6: This business conducts real estate sales and brokerage and rental property management. It is also promoting the disposal and sale of idle real estate held by group companies.
entries.fde3d97ef6913b32: This is a business that operates and manages mixed-use commercial facilities. Through continuous tenant turnover and the attraction of new formats, the occupancy rate shows a gradual upward trend.
